symbols.name: label space
symbols.meaning: The fixed space that contains every label.
symbols.quote: Fix a space $E$ of dimension $m$, the common space of all labels; here $m$ is that dimension, not the numerator of a dyadic rational.

symbols.name: label space dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the space E, a count of the vectors in a basis of E.
symbols.quote: Fix a space $E$ of dimension $m$, the common space of all labels; here $m$ is that dimension, not the numerator of a dyadic rational.

symbols.name: vertex
symbols.meaning: A gate or terminal of the network, the vertex that carries a label.
symbols.quote: Each vertex $w$ of the network, a gate or a terminal, carries a label $L(w)$, a subspace of $E$.

symbols.name: label
symbols.meaning: The label map, sending each vertex w to its subspace L(w) of E.
symbols.quote: Each vertex $w$ of the network, a gate or a terminal, carries a label $L(w)$, a subspace of $E$.

symbols.name: tail vertex
symbols.meaning: The vertex at which an edge starts.
symbols.quote: An edge runs from its tail $\sigma$ to its head $\nu$; these letters name vertices, not bank values.

symbols.name: head vertex
symbols.meaning: The vertex at which an edge ends.
symbols.quote: An edge runs from its tail $\sigma$ to its head $\nu$; these letters name vertices, not bank values.

symbols.name: label subspace
symbols.meaning: A label, a subspace of E carried by a gate or sink.
symbols.quote: Each gate or sink with label $U$ has a projection $P_U$ onto $U$ along its orthogonal complement $U^\perp$.

symbols.name: label projection
symbols.meaning: The projection onto U along its orthogonal complement U^perp.
symbols.quote: Each gate or sink with label $U$ has a projection $P_U$ onto $U$ along its orthogonal complement $U^\perp$.

symbols.name: smaller call count
symbols.meaning: The number of smaller calls, which is the total of the drops over all edges.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the total number of smaller calls, the sum of the drops over all edges.

relations.quote: The labels are chosen to make cheap the changes of [Frame of a vertex](frame.md) on each edge: the stored array at $w$ is $D_w g$ when the logical array is $g$, and along an edge from $\sigma$ to $\nu$ it changes by $D_\nu D_\sigma^{-1}$.
The labels are built on a [Subset-intersection finite network](subset-network.md).
Each label sits at a gate or at a [Source, sink and terminal of a network](network-terminal.md).
